▶ IN MOTION
01 — ABOUT

Behind the
Creative Work.

My creative journey started with graphic design — learning how colour, typography and layout make people stop and look. The moment I discovered animation and motion graphics, design stopped being still for me: a logo could move, type could perform, and a simple idea could become a story told in seconds.

Today, motion is my main language. I build animated content, promotional videos and kinetic typography, and I edit video with the same eye — timing, rhythm and transitions in Adobe After Effects and Adobe Premiere Pro are where a good cut becomes a great one.

What drives me is simple: turning an idea in someone's head into a visual experience an audience can feel — frame by frame.

Primary focusAnimation & motion graphics — 2D animation, logo animation, kinetic type, VFX
Also craftingGraphic design, branding, posters & social media design
On the timelineVideo editing, colour grading, transitions & audio sync
Core toolsAfter Effects · Premiere Pro · Photoshop · Illustrator · InDesign

My Original Work.

Real projects I produced myself, plus clearly labelled demonstration slots ready to be replaced with new work. Animated and video projects come first — that's where I live.

Motion Graphics · Promotional Video

AI Smart Glasses — Cinematic Motion Reel

A 45-second vertical (9:16) cinematic tech reel imagining a future where your phone lives in front of your eyes — five animated scenes covering the hook, AR navigation, an AI assistant, the big smartphone question, and a brand-style ending, all synced to confident English narration.

45 sec · 1080×19205 scenesMotion graphics + narration

Video Editing · Documentary

Mohenjo-daro — The Lost City (Documentary Series)

A 24-clip vertical documentary in Japanese about the 4,000-year-old Indus city — planned streets, the drainage system, the Great Bath and the undeciphered Indus script. Edited as one continuous 4-minute film, plus a tight 60-second best-parts cut of the six strongest clips.

02
